title: WorkerResultExample
description: Canonical WorkerResult contract returned by an economical worker to the supervisor or verification node. Labeled illustrative.
bounded_answer: In `src/token_context_mcp/retrieve/token_budget.py`, the `pack_by_budget` routine estimates token size using `ceil(utf8_bytes / 4)`. When an individual candidate item exceeds the remaining budget, the routine skips the entire item rather than slicing or streaming it. This poses a risk of dropping a large root symbol definition while retaining smaller secondary edge records.
